documents.title: Registro de la cosecha de junio
blocks: Dos fincas en una sola caja

La recolección abarcó del 2 al 4 de junio. Los granos de ambas fincas entraron en la misma caja el 4 de junio; las cáscaras de las mazorcas no se pesaron. El lote conserva los dos contribuyentes. No corresponde describirlo como cacao de una sola finca.

La diferencia entre 770 y 302 kg incluye drenaje y agua de secado. No hay mediciones separadas de sólidos de pulpa, drenaje o evaporación. El número de sacos no demuestra que cada uno pesara lo mismo.
Lecturas en el centro de la caja
Aroma más intenso y mayor drenaje.
Última visita registrada antes del cierre.

Descripción comercial: Nacional; no verificado genéticamente. No hay resultado de pH ni ensayo microbiológico. Las lecturas no constituyen una curva validada ni una autorización de calidad del chocolate terminado.

documents.title: Cuaderno de acopio: tickets y entrega
documents.desk: Río Verde Cacao Cooperative · Cuaderno de campo
blocks: El ticket de El Cedro llegó húmedo. Se copió el nombre legible en la copia de acopio y se guardó el original junto a ella. Los dos papeles corresponden a una sola contribución de 350 kg, no a dos entregas. Las Brisas aportó otros 420 kg.

Desde empaque se preguntó si bastaba con escribir Las Brisas en la caja. En el registro conjunto quedaron ambos nombres. Río Verde Cacao Cooperative identifica a la organización que reunió el material; Las Brisas y El Cedro identifican las fincas contribuyentes.
4.2 ha plantadas; sombra mixta; revisión del canal de drenaje.
3.6 ha plantadas; árboles de sombra más jóvenes; selección de mazorcas.

Las áreas plantadas no convierten estas contribuciones seleccionadas en un rendimiento anual de toda la finca. No se dispone de un conteo de mazorcas, asistencia de trabajadores ni dirección de hogares en este cuaderno.

La nota de aroma y drenaje se anotó aparte de la lectura central de 44.0 °C. Una impresión no sustituye al termómetro y el termómetro no identifica organismos. Los bordes de la caja no estaban instrumentados; no hay medición de oxígeno, resultado de pH ni ensayo microbiológico.
17 de junio · Lo que sale del acopio

El cierre de secado registra 302 kg frente a 770 kg húmedos. La salida agregada de 468 kg no está dividida entre visitas o superficies. No existía todavía un lote de chocolate terminado en este punto.
La fábrica debe conservar este cierre junto con su propia recepción. Una diferencia de transporte o una retención por humedad no cambia lo pesado en acopio ni elimina una finca del historial.

documents.title: Earlier Esmeraldas reference-lot card
documents.desk: Río Verde Cacao Cooperative · Reference archive
documents.date: Collection closed 18 May; archive review 1 October 2026
blocks: This earlier collection contains Las Brisas material only. El Cedro contributes to the later June collection, not this reference lot. The common region and product name do not make the two intakes interchangeable.

The trial roast was described as balanced cocoa with a mild floral impression. It is an internal sensory observation, not a guarantee for later harvests, a genetic identification or a finished-product certification.

The drying date is upstream of the factory start on 29 July and packing completion on 1 August. Harbor & Pine's shipment follows on 5 August. Its historical passport and this collection card are not rewritten by the later Northstar producer-display correction.

documents.title: Acta de relevos en el depósito
documents.date: Relevos de julio y agosto de 2026
blocks: Esta hoja relaciona las unidades de transporte con la ubicación de espera. Los códigos de pallet no son nuevos lotes de producción. La hoja de movimientos no cambia las cantidades despachadas ni la aceptación registrada por cada destinatario.

Todas las horas de esta tabla son locales al depósito, con desplazamiento UTC −06:00. No deben compararse como si fueran la hora de Seattle o de Portland. JT-P01 y NS-P01 permanecieron en S2; HP-P01 pasó por C1. No se registró apertura de envolturas interiores en estos relevos.

Las lecturas ambientales pertenecen al puesto de espera, no al interior del chocolate. Esta hoja no incluye un registrador continuo en los trayectos anteriores o posteriores, ni establece la hora en que apareció una alteración de superficie.
Archivo de recepción de granos · Suhum

El movimiento anterior de granos SUH-BEAN-2026-028 se conserva por separado: despacho de 282 kg el 25 de mayo, recepción de 280 kg el 18 de junio y derrame de 2 kg por un saco roto. La muestra destructiva de 1 kg fue una deducción posterior. No es el despacho de chocolate a Juniper.

documents.title: Suhum: cierre de secado y recepción
documents.desk: Asempanaye Growers Union · Patio de secado
documents.date: 5 de julio; anotación de recepción del 30 de julio de 2026
blocks: Los períodos de reposo bajo cubierta mantuvieron este material separado de la siguiente recolección. No hay observación de lluvia de una estación meteorológica ni pesos individuales de cada saco. Tampoco se midió una salida distinta para cada visita de secado.

Se recibieron 260 kg. Los 3 kg de diferencia corresponden a barridos contaminados descartados después de retirar sacos exteriores mojados; las bolsas interiores estaban intactas. La lectura de humedad fue 6.6% en base húmeda y no se ordenó un nuevo secado.

La muestra destructiva de 0.5 kg dejó 259.5 kg. Después se emitieron 210 kg a SUH-2026-031 y 20 kg a BLD-2026-060; el saldo de granos al 1 de octubre es 29.5 kg. La devolución de templado de agosto no es una pérdida adicional de estos granos.
El cierre de secado no libera chocolate terminado. SUH-2026-031 permanece listo para asignación, sin despacho. Su historial no es el del envío de julio shipment-suh-028.

documents.title: Piura reserve stock: pre-issue review
blocks: Record the bean-use review separately from the unresolved origin-status renewal. This is La Quebrada material from Valle Blanco Cooperative, harvested 6–8 November 2025 and received on 18 December 2025. Production in 2026 must not change its harvest year.

The recheck uses retained receiving material and does not book a second withdrawal from bulk bean stock. The receiving account's 1 kg sample deduction covers the material taken for checks; it is not an additional kilogram to remove again in August.

The recheck supports the recorded manufacturing-use decision before the 150 kg issue on 2 September. It is not a microbial release or a validation of all storage conditions. No site calibration certificate or microbial test accompanies this request.

Sourcing must complete the renewal review before changing the current status wording. Historical evidence and an inspection request do not supply that decision. Quality's finished-batch review remains separate and pending; the later handover has no packaging completion.
Review-file periods describe the records under review, not an automatic expiry rule for any real organic certification scheme.

documents.title: Sambirano receiving sample observation
blocks: The sample belongs to Ankify Orchard material supplied by Ambanja Cacao Collective. The trade description is Trinitario trade label; genotype unknown. The receiving sample was described as berry-like in a bench roast. The recipe was not yet finished.

The sensory description is an observation, not a specification for every bar. There is no temperature curve, acidity assay or genetic test attached. The origin-record wording describes a sourcing status; it does not identify an external certification scheme or establish fair-payment verification.

The factory issued 130 kg to SAM-2026-027, leaving 49.5 kg in bean stores after the sample deduction. The roasting entry notes a berry profile. The grinding entry says Grinding underway. It must not be read as a completed liquor yield.

Butter and sugar have not been issued. No packed bars, finished-quality release or final shipment passport exist for this run. No finished-product certification follows from the development observation or the direct-trade wording.

documents.title: Registro ambiental por ubicación de espera
documents.date: 23 de julio, 6 y 27 de agosto de 2026
blocks: LOGGER-17 estaba en un soporte exterior a la altura de los cartones, junto a BAY-S2. LOGGER-09 estaba en el estante de ROOM-C1. Ninguna sonda estaba dentro de una barra, envoltura o núcleo del pallet. Las cifras son temperatura del aire en °C, con incertidumbre declarada de ±0.5 °C; no se adjunta certificado de calibración.

La descarga de NS-AIR no contiene la muestra de las 16:00 del 27 de agosto. No se interpoló. Las otras muestras previstas a intervalos de 120 minutos están presentes; los máximos entre muestras siguen sin conocerse. La cobertura se limita a la permanencia en el depósito, no a todo el viaje.
Para relacionar una lectura con un envío, usar ubicación y ventana de permanencia de custody-statement.pdf. La temperatura ambiente no prueba la temperatura del producto ni una causa de defecto.
Archivo de ubicación ordinaria · Kokoo Ridge

SUH-BEAN-2026-032 sigue en inventario ordinario: 130 kg recibidos el 1 de agosto menos muestra de 0.5 kg = 129.5 kg. No se emitió a producción ni se extendió la revisión de Nkyene Grove a Kokoo Ridge.

documents.title: Duarte intake: sensory rejection and disposal
blocks: Disposition completed: reject from food production. No rescue blend authorized.
Loma Clara Cacao Circle / Loma Clara North
Smoke-like off-note repeated in two evaluations

The passing moisture result did not override the sensory rejection. The 1 kg transit spill occurred before the factory's 120 kg receipt and is not added to the 119 kg disposal quantity. Factory receipt reconciles as 120 = 1 + 119 kg.

The cooperative care note flags dryer-exhaust separation for review. That is a proposed investigation lead, not a proven cause. No measured exhaust exposure, fuel record or contamination assay is available.

Closure on 14 August records the completed disposition. It does not establish a verified repair at the farm, a safety finding about other lots or any certification conclusion. No factory batch, customer shipment or passport was created from this material.

documents.title: Esmeraldas arrival hold and re-dry review
documents.date: 14 July review; retained-specimen addendum through 3 September 2026
blocks: Hold followed by a new result
2 kg; split inner liners, rejected sweepings

The second reading does not overwrite the first. Origin-fact review on 12 July and bean-quality release on 14 July answer different questions. The August manufacturing issue came after the recorded release.

The water adjustment is calculated, not separately weighed water. With non-water mass held constant: 300 × (1 − 0.081) = 275.7 kg; 275.7 ÷ (1 − 0.069) = 296.133 kg after rounding to grams. The recorded adjustment assumes no solids loss during re-dry.

The sample is booked after that adjustment and counted once. This stock worksheet does not establish clock times for every sampling step or a measured division between evaporation and any other outflow.

No drying-equipment log, site calibration certificate, sample photograph or microbial test is provided. The release record is not a drying recipe, microbial kill-step validation or certification decision.

ESM042-RETAIN4 and SUH028-RETAIN4 each identify four of their batch's ten retained bars, inspected through sealed wrappers. They were not sent along the customer route. The repeated checks are not new withdrawals or destructive tests; each retention account remains 0.7 kg. A small visually unchanged control cannot exclude every production defect.
Only these retention-room spot measurements are supplied, with declared ±0.5 °C uncertainty. No continuous room history, crystal-form assay or microbial clearance accompanies them.

documents.title: Esmeraldas production traveler
blocks: Dates and operator names above belong to the production entries. They are not signatures or evidence that a production operator made the separate Quality or Sourcing decisions.

The bean issue was drawn from the June commingled lot containing Las Brisas and El Cedro material. The cooperative's 302 kg packed beans and the factory's 300 kg receipt remain upstream observations; neither is this run's issue quantity.

The close-out carries 200 kg liquor, 16 kg cocoa butter and 84 kg sugar, producing a 300 kg formulated mixture. The 6 kg post-mixing outflow leaves 294 kg packed chocolate: 4,200 nominal 70 g bars. Ten bars, 0.7 kg, move to retention within that total.
Finished-quality release is recorded on 22 August after final snap and temper inspection. This traveler does not allocate customer stock or authorize disclosure of its internal notes.

documents.title: Ecuador Esmeraldas 72%: batch close-out
blocks: Production began on 18 August and packaging completed on 22 August. Both dates are retained. The production traveler carries the stage entries; the final snap and temper inspection supports the recorded finished-quality release on 22 August.

The 250 kg bean issue came from ESM-BEAN-2026-042, the June Río Verde lot assembled from Las Brisas and El Cedro. The receiving hold on 12 July and release after a new sample on 14 July remain in that lot's history. The finished batch is not a single-farm collection.

250.0 = 200.0 + 10.0 + 32.5 + 7.5 kg. These are booked conversion allocations. No independent scale tickets or stage-loss assays accompany the allocation; the common conversion split is not an empirical yield standard.

The recipe uses 216 kg cocoa ingredients in 300 kg mixture, or 72%. The 6 kg outflow is carried at mixture composition for reconciliation; no stage-specific split or packed-bar composition assay is attached.

Origin wording concerns the tracked beans. Purchased butter has no assigned origin in these records. Organic verified is the origin-record status, not evidence of certification of every ingredient or the finished bar.

documents.title: Earlier Esmeraldas packing reconciliation
blocks: The formulation contains 171 kg cocoa ingredients in 237.5 kg mixture: 72%. Bean conversion is accounted before butter and sugar enter the mixture. Shells are not counted again as a packing loss.
Packing completed, not all stock dispatched

The packaging entry is 1 August at 14:05 UTC, Cases sealed, recorded by Camila Ortiz. Finished release is recorded without exception. The 196 kg Harbor & Pine allocation leaves on 5 August, not on this packing date.

After that dispatch the factory retains 38.5 kg ordinary finished stock and the separate 0.7 kg retention allocation. Together with the dispatch these exhaust the 235.2 kg packed output. Carton and pallet tare are excluded.
This run uses the earlier Las Brisas collection. The later June intake and Northstar name correction do not alter its material account or historical issuance.
Same-batch stock still at the factory

The comparison uses sealed visual checks and leaves the bars on hand. A shared wrapper-lot code does not establish a common seal defect or an intact wrapper at every stage. No water-vapour transmission test or wrapper composition assay is attached.

documents.title: Juniper run: recipe and close-out review
documents.date: 17 July close-out; issue comparison through 24 August 2026
blocks: Liquor plus cocoa butter contributes 204 kg of the 300 kg formulation: 68%. The bean-origin wording is Suhum, Ghana, supplied by Asempanaye Growers Union. The purchased butter is not assigned that bean origin.

Packing completed on 17 July at 15:30 UTC, following the recorded roasting, grinding, conching and tempering entries. The production note records the final retention sample as archived. Ten bars, 0.7 kg, remain in the retained-product account.

Origin-status wording was reviewed on 18 July. The origin record reads Fair trade verified. That wording does not supply an external scheme certificate or authorize a Fairtrade seal, and it is not finished-product certification. Supporting evidence scope is addressed in the assurance review.

The 6 kg outflow is an aggregate manufacturing entry, not a measured allocation to each machine. Its accounting composition follows the mixture. No additional loss is deducted from bean stores after the full 230 kg issue.
The recipe review is not shipment permission. Juniper's 280 kg dispatch follows on 22 July and is reconciled separately from the upstream dried-bean movement.

The same purchased lots appear in more than one production run. Ingredient identity alone does not distinguish a route, storage history or outcome. The origin and certification of purchased butter remain unassigned; no new ingredient safety approval or assay is asserted.

documents.title: Suhum same-batch temper return
blocks: Same-batch return only. No new material input and no second production-output entry.

Cosmetic bloom was noted on 200 unwrapped bars before final packing. Quality recorded approval for a same-batch remelt. This ticket records the accounting disposition; it provides no rework operating temperatures or validated safety procedure.
New production counted for the return
The return remains inside the run account. Counting the 14 kg again as new packed output would inflate stock. The 5.6 kg ordinary process outflow is not a second rework loss.

The final temper entry on 27 August at 10:45 UTC says Temper passed; packaging at 14:30 UTC says Awaiting shipment. The batch is ready, not shipped. No foreign lot or ingredient was introduced by the return; no allergen change is recorded.

A visually unchanged retained cohort is not a crystal-form result or proof that every bar is defect-free. This batch remains ready, not shipped. Its pre-packing same-run return must not be assigned to Juniper's July batch or Northstar's August batch.

documents.title: Piura end-of-shift quality handover
blocks: Status: quality-review. Packaging not complete; no finished-stock transfer.
La Quebrada bean issue on 2 September

The recorded conching entry is 4 September at 12:00 UTC, Fruit notes prominent. The tempering entry is 5 September at 10:10 UTC, Sample bars prepared. There is no packaging-completion entry. Sample bars do not establish a released packed-bar tally.
Peru Piura Blanco 70% is the intended product. Liquor and butter total 126 kg of the 180 kg mixture, giving the recipe's 70%. The WIP account is not a nominal packed-bar count.

The bean-use recheck preceded the production issue. Finished-quality approval remains pending, and the origin record remains Organic pending renewal. No release operator, signature or approval date is supplied to fill those gaps.
The harvest year stays 2025 even though manufacturing began on 2 September 2026. No order is allocated and no dispatch date or final passport exists for this run.

documents.title: Sambirano work-in-progress tag
blocks: IN PRODUCTION · Grinding underway · Do not transfer to finished stock.

The entry labeled grinding contains an underway note. It does not prove grinding completion or a measured liquor quantity. The 104 kg liquor figure in the scheduling calculation is an expected recovery, not a stock measurement to print as actual WIP.

No conching completion date or production-completion date is recorded on this handoff. No restart time or reason for the stop is supplied. The planned 74% formulation has not been made, and ingredient withdrawals must not be inferred from the product name.

Keep this tag with the scheduling handoff. The next entry needs actual intermediate quantity, completed work and any ingredient issues. Do not create a final passport from a product label while finished release and shipment are absent.

documents.title: Sambirano grinding-stage handoff
blocks: The run began on 8 September with 130 kg of released Ankify Orchard beans. Roasting has an entry at 08:20 UTC. The grinding entry at 14:00 UTC says Grinding underway. The timestamp alone must not override that note or turn an intermediate stage into a completed yield.

No intermediate mass measurement is supplied. The batch remains in production. Butter and sugar issues are zero, and no conching, tempering or packaging completion is recorded. Finished-quality review is pending.

The planning split exhausts the 130 kg input, but its output categories are not measured completions. It cannot serve as a physical intermediate-stock count or evidence of a fault at a particular machine.
The intended mixture is 150 kg, with 111 kg cocoa ingredients: 74%. That percentage belongs to the planned recipe, not to unfinished pure-liquor material. It is not a promise of 150 kg packed bars.

No restart time, explanation of the stop or final packed outcome is recorded. The next handoff must distinguish actual measurements from this scheduling calculation. Direct trade verified remains origin-record wording, not finished-product certification.

documents.title: Two-origin blend: label-scope review
documents.desk: Cocoarynth · Label custody and Data Governance
blocks: The product wording is Two-Origin Workshop Blend 70%. The run physically mixes beans from two identified lots. It must not acquire a new single-origin harvest description because the inputs each had origin-status review.
Quality released the packed run on 18 September. The label-scope review closes on 20 September. The recipe contains 35 kg cocoa ingredients in 50 kg mixture: 70%. Butter's origin remains unassigned.

No composite certification statement is approved. Organic verified and Fair trade verified are separate input-origin record labels; neither supplies certification of this blend. No order, dispatch or passport is recorded.
This is a physical mixture account, not a purchasing-credit claim under an external certification scheme. Label approval does not create a customer or permission to share internal source documents.

documents.title: Bean stores: 1 October movement review
blocks: Balances below start at factory receipt, after transit differences. All quantities are net dried-bean kilograms. Factory issues leave bean stores in full; their later liquor and shell accounts must not be deducted here again.

The Duarte zero balance is a completed non-food disposition, not a shipment. Kokoo Ridge's 129.5 kg is physically on hand without a factory issue or affirmative assurance statement. Piura's historical harvest and open renewal do not change its bean quantity.
These are movement-derived book balances, not a new warehouse scale count. No unexplained adjustment or certification-credit ledger is included.

documents.title: Notas de espera y tarjeta de ingredientes
documents.date: Notas de muelle; cierre de ingredientes al 1 de octubre de 2026
blocks: Los tres puntos de humedad relativa no cubren toda la permanencia. El registrador estaba fuera de los cartones. Que el exterior estuviera seco no descarta condensación dentro de una envoltura; no se midió el punto de rocío ni la superficie de la barra. No se afirma que la falta de control de S2 explique un defecto específico.

Los retiros efectivamente registrados incluyen los lotes terminados, Piura en revisión y la mezcla. SAM-2026-027 no tiene retiro de manteca ni azúcar: los 7 y 39 kg son planificados. Los saldos no incluyen reservas futuras, tara ni certificación de ingredientes.

documents.title: Finished product and WIP: custody summary
blocks: Each row reconciles packed output to retention, dispatched stock and ordinary factory stock. Retention is a transfer of ten nominal 70 g bars, not manufacturing loss. A shipped status does not mean the whole run left the factory.
Work in progress is not finished stock
130 kg beans issued; grinding underway; intermediate mass not supplied
Sambirano's 104 kg expected liquor recovery remains a scheduling calculation and is not a verified stock count. Piura's temper sample is not a packaging-completion record.

Northstar holds 207.2 kg accepted and 2.8 kg quarantined from the 210 kg dispatch. That quarantine is outside factory stock; no return is recorded. Harbor & Pine accepted 196 kg and Juniper accepted 280 kg.
This summary is a book reconciliation, not a physical count or permission to release stock. There is no recorded replacement allocation, credit or dispatch for the Northstar damage case.

documents.title: Northstar: despacho y aceptación de llegada
blocks: El destino sigue siendo Seattle, WA. El producto es Ecuador Esmeraldas 72%, empacado el 22 de agosto. Los 207.2 kg aceptados y los 2.8 kg retenidos suman los 210 kg despachados. Las 40 barras dañadas son la misma retención de 2.8 kg, no otra deducción.

El acta de relevo identifica la espera del pallet; el registro de llegada no determina cuándo ocurrió el daño. NS-042-DAMAGE permanece abierto, sin devolución, reemplazo o crédito registrado. El pedido está cumplido para asignación y despacho, no resuelto para el reclamo financiero.

Las observaciones posteriores de NS-042-SURFACE proceden de una muestra del stock aceptado. No cambian esta recepción ni convierten las 40 barras de llegada en una medición de película blanca. La corrección del nombre del productor también es un expediente aparte.

documents.title: Northstar: arrival claim and later surface observations
blocks: shipment-esm-042 delivered 210 kg from ESM-2026-042. On 28 August Northstar accepted 207.2 kg and quarantined 2.8 kg, or 40 bars. NS-042-DAMAGE is the open financial arrival claim. The record does not identify when or how the damage occurred.

A later surface complaint opened as NS-042-SURFACE on 31 August. It concerns a selected cohort within accepted stock, not a reclassification of the 40 arrival-quarantine bars or a new whole-shipment damaged quantity. No return, replacement dispatch or customer credit is recorded.
Same selected cohort, repeated visual checks

Counts are repeated checks of the same bars and must not be added across dates. Bars remained in recipient custody and sealed inner wrappers. The surface description and less-sharp corners are visual observations, not a snap-force test, crystal-form assay, taste test or microbial diagnosis.

These rack readings are isolated points with declared ±0.5 °C uncertainty, not continuous storage coverage. Overnight peaks and transport legs remain unknown. No calibration certificate is supplied. Support has not assigned causality from a rack reading or appearance.

Compare only matched cohort identities and handling records. Factory controls do not certify every bar, and a surface complaint does not by itself establish microbial spoilage or safe consumption. Disposition remains subject to Quality review.

documents.title: Harbor & Pine receiving acknowledgment
documents.date: Receipt 7 August; visual follow-up through 3 September 2026
blocks: The accepted quantity equals this shipment's allocated dispatch. It is less than the whole run's 235.2 kg packed output because Cocoarynth retains 38.5 kg ordinary finished stock and 0.7 kg retention stock.
The desk register records passport-esm-2026-039 at 5 August 16:00 UTC. This receipt concerns that original issuance and this batch, not a newer Northstar replacement for ESM-2026-042.

No damage case is recorded for this receipt. That result is specific to the receiving record and is not a general guarantee of all later handling. No handwritten signature or recipient notification is represented on this copy.
The 70 kg Harbor & Pine inquiry cancelled later in August is a different order. It must not reverse or replace this fulfilled 196 kg movement.

The sampled bars retained their even visible surface. These are sealed, non-destructive checks, not clearance of all 196 kg. HP-P01 followed its own route and staging history. Shared product or wrapper wording is not evidence that it occupied the same position as another pallet.

documents.title: Juniper: complete receipt and later quality follow-up
blocks: Juniper Table Provisions received Ghana Suhum 68% in Denver, CO. Production started 14 July and packing completed 17 July. Of 294 kg packed, 280 kg was dispatched, 13.3 kg remains ordinary factory stock and 0.7 kg remains retention. No arrival damage deduction is recorded.

JT-028-SURFACE opened on 28 July after the full receipt. Counts concern the same selected bars, not cumulative losses or an estimate for all 280 kg. Inner wrappers stayed sealed; no destructive sample, tasting or composition assay is recorded.

These dated spot checks carry ±0.5 °C declared uncertainty; they do not rule out unobserved storage excursions. Transit placement is recorded separately against JT-P01. Retained factory specimens belong to the same batch but did not follow that pallet.

The order remains fulfilled and the surface case remains open. The current passport is passport-suh-2026-028, with no replacement. No credit, return, product recall, causal finding or safety clearance is supplied by this follow-up.

documents.title: Northstar support chronology
documents.date: 31 August chronology; case position at 1 October 2026
blocks: Producer-display review opened; issued content preserved.
207.2 kg accepted; 2.8 kg quarantined; claim opened.
Distinct replacement entered; wording case closed.
Precise-location request opened for visit planning.
Denied decision recorded; location request closed.
Financial claim still open; no remedy movement recorded.
What the closed tickets do not close

The name correction preserves batch, harvest, origin-status wording, production milestones and shipment. The location decision is a separate purpose-and-field review. Neither ticket changes custody of the 40 quarantined bars or establishes a refund.

The original passport-esm-2026-042 remains retained beside passport-esm-2026-042-r2. The replacement is a desk issuance record under ADR-007, not evidence that the application's on-demand service stores version history.

No replacement-delivery acknowledgment or location-request notification is recorded. Use the approved baseline field set and channel; do not append internal quality notes, employee comments or prices to explain a case.
Later surface cases: separate from arrival and wording

A later visual complaint does not change the earlier receipt or establish the same mechanism as arrival damage. The wording correction and location denial retain their original scope and closure dates. None is a diagnosis of a surface observation.

documents.title: Origin Passport desk register
blocks: This desk register retains the recorded shareable values and issuance history. It does not assert application-side snapshot persistence or prove that a replacement reached a recipient. Older issued content remains unchanged when lifecycle status is updated.

The productionDate value in the original app representation is the start date, 2026-08-18. Completion is retained as desk evidence for format mapping, not a claim that the JSON response includes a completion field. New identity and producer wording are the only changed business-payload values.

Sourcing's correction approval is dated 28 August. The supersession link is register metadata; it does not rewrite the original producer value. Retention of a record does not renew sharing authority. Northstar's baseline purpose and channel expire on 31 December 2026.

Origin status strings are retained as recorded, not shortened into seal or finished-product claims. The assurance review distinguishes those strings from supporting certification scope. This register supplies the retained values, identities and supersession relationship for the listed desk issuances.

ADR-007 governs historical stability and replacement identity. OPS-OP-012 governs verification and delivery. Neither proves that the current app implements an immutable store, and neither records a missing recipient acknowledgment.

documents.title: Northstar producer-display correction
blocks: Approved change: producer display wording only. Cooperative identity and material history unchanged.

Ecuador Esmeraldas 72%, batch ESM-2026-042, harvest year 2026, cacao percentage 72 and origin status Organic verified remain as recorded. Production began 18 August, packing completed 22 August, and shipment-esm-042 left for Northstar on 26 August.

The farm contributions remain Las Brisas and El Cedro. No material was moved, no receipt quantity changed and no damage disposition was settled by the corrected display name. The earlier Harbor & Pine issuance retains its historical wording.

The desk retains the original beside the distinct replacement under ADR-007. The wording case closes on the register entry, not on a documented recipient acknowledgment. Application-side persistence and delivery are not asserted.

The comma in the approved producer wording is significant for a future CSV serializer. Proper quoting would be required. This sourcing decision does not create a Mapayça shipment or a completed pilot file.

documents.title: Origin status and assurance scope review
blocks: Recorded wording is not a seal entitlement
Named origin lots; not all ingredients or finished bars.
Nkyene Grove lots; Kokoo Ridge not covered.
Sourcing status, not a third-party certification.
Input reviews do not certify a mixture.

No certification-body decision, certificate number or permission to use a seal is supplied by these records. Keep the established origin status strings intact, but do not interpret them as proof of a particular USDA, Fairtrade or Rainforest Alliance scheme or as certification of purchased butter, sugar or finished chocolate.
Renewal review opened 25 August; still pending.
Label scope reviewed 20 September; no combined claim.

The historical Piura file covers 2025, while the current review concerns 2026 use. Its pending state is not evidence of a failed farm audit. Calendar periods in the review file are not automatic certificate-expiry rules for an external scheme.

Passing physical checks does not approve certification wording. A supporting certificate containing extra names or identifiers would also require a separate disclosure and redaction review under DG-TR-004.

documents.title: Harbor & Pine: consulta cancelada y seguimiento
documents.date: 28 de agosto; seguimiento al 3 de septiembre de 2026
blocks: La consulta no es el envío anterior

La consulta de Harbor & Pine Grocers abrió el 20 de agosto por 70 kg y se canceló el 28 de agosto. No tiene asignación activa, despacho ni recepción. No consume ni devuelve producto. El envío anterior de 196 kg de ESM-2026-039 sigue cumplido.

SUH-2026-031 permanece listo después de la devolución de templado y el empaque del 27 de agosto. El saldo ordinario es 273.7 kg y la retención separada 0.7 kg. La cancelación no proporciona fecha de despacho ni pasaporte final para ese lote.

HP-P01 pasó por ROOM-C1 según el acta de muelle. La revisión visual de HP-RETAIL20 se guarda en receipt-acknowledgment.pdf, con sus fechas y tamaño de muestra. Es una muestra de recepción, no una garantía de todo el stock o de toda la cadena.

El seguimiento no asigna stock nuevo, no aprueba un cambio de receta y no permite reutilizar este envío para Mapayça. Comparar observaciones requiere conservar lote, pallet, ubicación y período, no sólo el nombre comercial.

documents.title: Mapayça pilot: open handoff exception
blocks: OPEN · Format-blocked order · No allocated batch or shipment.

The application does not implement CSV export. Renaming a JSON download cannot meet the contract. Independently, the order has no allocation or shipment facts from which to form a completed pilot row.

Northstar's shipment-esm-042 belongs to Northstar. Its batch and dispatch date cannot be copied into a Mapayça row to hide the missing movement. The pilot document's illustrative September example is not an actual allocation for this order.
Evidence to retain for the handoff

OPS-OP-012 calls for file identity, generation time, observed filename and media type, exact partner error and format-aware parser results when an import fails. No actual attempted Mapayça upload or importer error is recorded in this exception; this is a prospective capability gap.

Do not promise a supported format, generate a fictitious dispatch date or send internal quality notes as an alternative. The detailed field/date mapping is in the integration brief; no implementation or completed transfer is asserted.

blocks: The requested row has no current shipment

MM-TR-PILOT-01 requires exactly these headers in this order, one header row and one complete data row, UTF-8, .csv and text/csv. Empty optional fields stay present. Commas, double quotes and line breaks require standard quoting; embedded quotes are doubled. Bulk export is not required.
Names that look similar can mean different things
Must use the actual exported batch's completion evidence.

This comparison explains the mapping risk; it does not assign ESM-2026-042 to Mapayça. A name-only camelCase-to-snake_case conversion would copy a start date into a completion field. A download date or case date cannot fill shipment_date.

GET /api/batches/:batchId/passport returns an allowlisted JSON object for a shipped batch with a shipment. Unknown batches return 404; an unshipped batch cannot produce a final passport and returns 409. The response is constructed from current records, not retrieved from a persisted immutable issuance store.

ADR-007 requires stable issued values, new identity for a correction and retention of the old issuance. ENG-API-02 requires a reviewed export contract and tests of actual serialized bytes and headers. These requirements do not establish completed implementation.

A supported CSV serializer must preserve authorized snapshot values, exact columns, quoting, encoding and date meanings. The actual recipient order also needs allocation and dispatch records plus the scoped sharing decision. None is supplied by the existence of this brief.

Keep certification_status within its approved evidence scope. Do not transform an origin-record label into a finished-product certification. Do not add prices, contacts, employee details, quality notes, credentials or private system identifiers.

documents.title: Northstar precise-location request decision
blocks: DENIED · Precise farm location for visit planning. Baseline traceability permission remains separate.

The new purpose and field fall outside the baseline shipment-traceability permission. DG-TR-004 requires separate Data Governance and responsible-business-owner approval for precise location disclosure; no such permission is granted by this decision.

Reviewed country, region and cooperative wording remain eligible under the existing baseline. That does not authorize a farm visit, a new channel, internal quality notes or every document in the support folder.

The request closes when the denied decision is entered. No partner notification, farm visit, collection of coordinates or future access grant is recorded. The partner record contains no household coordinates, personal email addresses or phone numbers; that does not mean the internal application lacks private contacts.

documents.title: Northstar: scope of the location denial
blocks: One request denied, not every origin statement

The precise-location request concerns farm visit planning. The recorded denial is specific to that purpose and field. The existing wholesale-origin-traceability authorization remains tied to Northstar Specialty Foods, shipment-esm-042 and the partner portal, approved 26 August and expiring 31 December 2026.

The original purpose selects reviewed passport identity, product, batch, country, region, producer wording, harvest year, cacao percentage, origin-status wording and relevant production/shipment dates. It does not authorize unrestricted source-record access.

Several approvals refer to the same material or movement. That does not merge their subjects. A source-fact review is not release permission, a quality release is not sharing permission, and an origin statement is not approval to send a certificate containing extra identifiers.
What Support can and cannot infer

Support may use the approved snapshot within the baseline purpose and channel while that authorization remains valid. Internal quality notes, employee comments, negotiated pricing and private system data stay excluded. Contacts, precise locations and supporting documents need the separate reviews specified by DG-TR-004.

No household coordinates, personal emails or phone numbers appear in this partner record. That absence supplies no new permission to collect or disclose them. Internal origin records contain private contact fields that remain outside the export.

Closure records the denial, not completed communication or a farm visit. Retaining a historical artifact does not extend permission beyond 31 December. No sharing decision or shipment is supplied for Mapayça.

documents.title: Trace passport service: capability review
blocks: The reviewed route is GET /api/batches/:batchId/passport. It uses the batch catalog and requires shipped status plus an existing shipment. An unknown batch receives 404; an unavailable final passport receives 409. Successful downloads are application/json with an origin-passport-{batchNumber}.json filename.
passport-{lower-case batch number}; derived, not a persisted issuance ID.
Origin harvest year and product recipe percentage.
Batch start date in the reviewed records.
UTC timestamp created for this request.

These are the twelve response properties; source objects are not serialized wholesale. Private contacts, negotiated prices, internalQualityNotes, production operator names and stage notes remain outside this response.
Required behavior not established by the route

The service constructs each response from mutable input records. Its timestamp does not prove that it retains immutable snapshot history, creates distinct replacements or presents supersession. The PDF desk register is a separate custody record, not evidence of application-side persistence.

CSV serialization is not implemented. MM-TR-PILOT-01 requires CSV and finished-production completion, so a correct-looking JSON response or filename change cannot meet the pilot. The engineering standards effective 15 September define release expectations, not retrospective conformance evidence.
This review covers the pinned service and fixtures. It makes no claim about new ingredient inventory, WIP, recipient quarantine, allocation controls or portal delivery capabilities.

documents.title: Quantity basis and surface-review reference letter
documents.desk: Cocoarynth · Stock accounting letter to Operations
blocks: Keep the material stage attached to the number

Wet beans with pulp, received dried beans, liquor, formulated chocolate and packed bars describe different materials. The June Esmeraldas 770 kg collection, 302 kg cooperative packing, 300 kg factory receipt and 250 kg manufacturing issue must not collapse into one repeated quantity.

The factory conversion worksheets use a booked split of 4% roast outflow, 13% shells, 3% other bean-processing outflow and 80% liquor. The split is an accounting allocation, not a measured stage-yield specification or a country average. No individual stage scale tickets are supplied. For Sambirano it remains a planning calculation because grinding is underway.

Cacao percentage uses liquor plus added cocoa butter divided by formulated mixture. The Esmeraldas recipe is (200 + 16) / 300 = 72%. Bean shells and roast outflows have already left the conversion account; they are not ingredients or a second packing deduction.

Post-mixing outflows are carried at mixture composition for reconciliation. That preserves the recipe percentage arithmetically, but it is not a chemical assay of packed bars or a measured stage-by-stage loss analysis. The nominal 70 g bar converts booked mass to count; it is not proof of scale calibration or exact weight of every bar.

The 3.867 kg re-dry adjustment is calculated from wet-basis readings while holding non-water mass constant, rounded to grams. It is not a second transit loss. Destructive samples leave usable stock; retained finished samples move between product accounts. Neither planned ingredients nor same-run remelt creates new stock.

No equipment-energy record, microbial reduction, fermentation chemistry, sample-confidence interval or industrial scrap-composition assay accompanies these accounts. The figures are not operating instructions, food-safety validation or evidence of certification-system compliance.

Physical lot identity and purchasing-credit systems answer different questions. The two-origin blend physically mixes two bean lots; input-origin status does not grant a composite certificate or seal. A certification body and permitted-use review would be separate sources of evidence.

The following references concern general cocoa practice and claim interpretation. They are not the source of these lot measurements, company decisions or permissions. No public-source prose is reproduced as a farmer's or operator's quotation.
FAO · Growing cocoa, historical introductory manual
USDA AMS · How to become certified organic
FDA · Additional traceability records for certain foods
These are background references, not an assertion that FDA's rule applies to every product here or that a real organic certificate automatically expires annually.
Application evidence used in the capability review

Relevant files are server/data/origins.ts, products.ts, batches.ts and shipments.ts; server/services/originPassport.ts; server/routes/passports.ts; and shared/types.ts. Controlled requirements are retained unchanged as companion PDFs.
Surface changes: general mechanism, not a batch finding

Purdue Extension's Cocoa Processing: Tempering distinguishes fat bloom associated with poor tempering or storage temperature fluctuations from sugar bloom associated with water condensing on a chocolate surface, dissolving sugar and leaving crystals after evaporation. Both mechanisms concern physical surface change. Appearance alone does not identify which material is present in a particular complaint.

Cocoa-butter crystal stability affects gloss, snap and texture. External air temperature and a finished-product core temperature are not interchangeable; neither an ambient peak nor a nominal melting range proves that a given wrapped bar melted. Recipes, exposure duration and location within a pallet matter. No universal defect threshold is specified here.

The technical references do not establish a microbial result or permission to eat, rework or release complaint stock. These case records contain no crystal-form, deposit-composition, water-activity or microbial assay. Keep analytical identification and any disposition decision with the responsible Quality review.
